 Mrs.Anjali S. Shinde a/w Mr.Nitin P. Deshpande for the Petitioner.
 Dr.B.G. Saraf, Advocate General a/w Mr.P.P. Kakade, Gp with
 Mr.S.H.Kankal, Agp for State.

__________
 Coram : G. S. Kulkarni &
 Jitendra S. Jain, Jj.

Having heard learned Advocate General for State on the backdrop of our detailed order dated 18 th October 2020, we may clarify that the concerns which we had expressed in our order is not in regard to the Maharashtra Project Affected Persons Rehabilitation Act, 1999 (for short "the 1999 Act) being rendered unconstitutional but in considering the judicial notice which we have taken in the indiscriminate application of such law and moreso in the context of the coming into force of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (for short "the 2013 Act")

sentences.text: Also our concern was in regard to the selective application of the 1999 Act to different projects.
We hope that our observations would be considered by the Government at the appropriate level for any policy decision to be taken on the concerns as raised by us in our order dated 18 th October 2023.
4. Let an appropriate affidavit be placed on record.

5. Stand over to 24th January 2024 H.O.B. [JITENDRA S JAIN, J.] [G. S. KULKARNI, J.]
